title: Already blocked or disabled card - explained
keywords: my debit card is blocked only
aliases: my debit card is blocked only
content: A card may be restricted after repeated incorrect PIN attempts or a security check. Avoid repeated attempts and check any message in your trusted banking app. A restriction does not always require a new card; support must check the reason before advising replacement.
